Hymn 134: I Believe in Christ
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: John Longhurst
Lyricist/Text Author: Bruce R. McConkie
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 134 titled "I Believe in Christ" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John Longhurst and the lyrics were written by Bruce R. McConkie.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
